$comment: Single source of the Shuttlegent mark. ExportBrand.ps1 renders every mark, lockup and icon from it and writes Resources/Web/brand-geometry.js for the panel's animated marks.

threads.$comment: Warp threads with round ends, left to right; the side threads are centred on the shuttle's axis line, the middle one is the tallest and the only one in front

shuttle.$comment: Silhouette along axisDeg; profile rows are [distance from centre along the axis, half thickness], joined by a closed Catmull-Rom spline

$commentWeave: Depth order back to front: threads without front, shuttle, threads with front

palettes.$comment: knockout: one-colour palettes cut a gap of knockoutGap around the front shape so the weave stays readable
